name: Office gym 12-week strength and hypertrophy (hockey-adjusted)
summary: 12 weeks, Monday to Wednesday: lower body, upper push and pull, upper hypertrophy. Three 4-week phases with deloads in weeks 4 and 8.
notes:
3-month office gym strength and hypertrophy plan, adjusted for hockey.

Days: Monday (A, lower body and core), Tuesday (B, upper push and pull), Wednesday (C, upper hypertrophy, arms and prehab). Thursday and Saturday are ice hockey; Sunday is active recovery (swim and sauna). Monday carries the heavy lower-body work after Sunday recovery; Wednesday avoids heavy posterior-chain and spinal loading before Thursday hockey.

Equipment: barbell, dumbbells, EZ-bar, flat/incline bench, ab roller.

Month 1, accumulation (weeks 1-4): compounds 8-10 reps, accessories 12-15, core 10-12, RPE about 7.5, rest 120 s compound / 75 s accessory.
Month 2, intensification (weeks 5-8): compounds 6-8, accessories 10-12, core 12-15, RPE about 8, rest 150 s / 90 s.
Month 3, peak strength (weeks 9-12): compounds 5-6, accessories 8-12, core 15, RPE about 8.5, rest 180 s / 75 s.
Weeks 4 and 8 are deloads; week 12 is a taper. Each calendar session carries that week's load and set instruction.

plans.name: Office M1 Day A: lower body and core
plans.description: Month 1 (accumulation and volume base), target RPE 7.5. Hypertrophy, tendon conditioning and work capacity without CNS burnout.

exercises.notes: Controlled 3 s eccentric; stop just below the knee to keep hamstring tension and protect the lower back.
Weight is per hand (month 1 base 16 kg). Reps per leg. Slight forward torso lean to mimic the skating stride and recruit the glutes.
Deep range of motion, 1 s pause at the bottom.
Weight is per hand (month 1 base 20 kg). 1 s peak contraction at the top.
Keep a posterior pelvic tilt throughout; do not let the lower back sag.

plans.name: Office M1 Day B: upper body push and pull
plans.description: Month 1 (accumulation and volume base), target RPE 7.5. Hypertrophy, tendon conditioning and work capacity without CNS burnout.

exercises.notes: Retracted scapula, controlled touch on the lower chest, explosive press.
Underhand or semi-supinated grip; pull toward the hips or lower abdomen.
Weight is per hand (month 1 base 16 kg). Smooth rotational path; avoid locking the elbows at the top.
Slight bend in the elbows; focus on the thoracic and lat stretch.

exercises.exercise_name: Dumbbell farmer's walk or static hold
exercises.notes: Weight is per hand (month 1 base 24 kg). One rep = one 45-60 s walk or hold, for grip and forearm endurance.

plans.description: Month 1 (accumulation and volume base), target RPE 7.5. Hypertrophy, tendon conditioning and work capacity without CNS burnout.

weeks.note: Week 1 of 12, RPE 7. Load: 100% of base working weight. Sets/reps: Target sets as listed. Establish baseline rep speeds and log exact reps achieved.
Week 2 of 12, RPE 7.5. Load: 100% of base working weight. Sets/reps: Add 1 rep per set across all exercises. Volume progression via reps before adding external load.
Week 3 of 12, RPE 8. Load: +2.5 kg on barbell/EZ-bar lifts, +1-2 kg on dumbbells. Sets/reps: Target sets as listed. Peak accumulation week for month 1.
Week 4 of 12, RPE 6. Load: 85% of week 3 weights. Sets/reps: -1 set on all exercises. Deload week to clear cumulative fatigue from gym plus 2x weekly hockey.

Week 5 of 12, RPE 7.5. Load: +2.5 kg over week 3 weights on barbell RDL (67.5-70 kg) and bench press (72.5 kg). Sets/reps: Target sets as listed. Drop to 6-8 reps on primary compounds; focus on bar speed.
Week 6 of 12, RPE 8. Load: Keep week 5 weights. Sets/reps: Add 1 rep per set on compounds (aim for the top of 6-8). Consolidate strength gains.

Week 7 of 12, RPE 8.5. Load: +2.5 kg on barbell bench (75 kg) and RDL (70-72.5 kg); +1-2 kg on DB split squats and rows. Sets/reps: Target sets as listed. Heaviest week of month 2. Cap Monday RDL at RPE 8.5 to protect the lower back.
Week 8 of 12, RPE 6. Load: 85% of week 7 weights. Sets/reps: -1 set on all exercises. Deload week.
Week 9 of 12, RPE 8. Load: Use week 7 weights for sets of 5-6 reps. Sets/reps: Target sets as listed. Clean, explosive lifting phase on bench press, RDL and split squats.
Week 10 of 12, RPE 8.5. Load: +2.5 kg on barbell bench (77.5 kg) and RDL (75 kg). Sets/reps: Target sets as listed. Keep strict technique; do not sacrifice depth or tempo.
Week 11 of 12, RPE 9. Load: Hold week 10 weights, or +2.5 kg if week 10 was below RPE 8.5. Sets/reps: Aim for 5-6 clean reps across all working sets. Peak strength test week of the block.
Week 12 of 12, RPE 5.5. Load: 80% of week 11 weights. Sets/reps: 2 sets per exercise only. Full taper and recovery week before the next cycle.
